meta.title: A vendor self-participates on an open tender
gaps: Establish or verify the open_tenders gate and an active event listed in the vendor's open events; the prepared state provides only default settings.
Sign into the vendor portal as an uninvited vendor, find the open tender, and participate.
Assert Joined in the vendor's view after self-participation.
Assert the joined event appears in the vendor's Live list; the prepared events list is buyer-side.
Verify the buyer's participant list records that vendor with source self-registered; no self-registration can be established with this fixed invited-vendor state.
